posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
The shipping prices you see on our website reflect the actual amount that we are charged for shipping (they are derived directly from the FedEx website). We are looking at ways to lowers that cost for our international backers, but at this time those are the prices we have to charge.

The other option is talking to a local gaming store about carrying our games. We are currently in distribution all over the world, so most stores should be able to get ahold of it (including the mini-expansions). If they can't, have them contact me and we might be able to work out a wholesale deal.
